entries.title: Deuteronomy 30:1
segments: ¶And it shall come to pass, when all these things are come upon thee, the blessing and the curse, which I have set before thee, and thou shalt take them to heart among all the nations whither Jehovah thy God hath driven thee,

entries.title: Deuteronomy 30:2
segments: and shalt return to Jehovah thy God, and shalt hearken to his voice according to all that I command thee this day, thou and thy sons, with all thy heart and with all thy soul;

entries.title: Deuteronomy 30:3
segments: that then Jehovah thy God will turn thy captivity, and have compassion upon thee, and will gather thee again from all the peoples whither Jehovah thy God hath scattered thee.

entries.title: Deuteronomy 30:4
segments: Though there were of you driven out unto the end of the heavens, from thence will Jehovah thy God gather thee, and from thence will he fetch thee;

entries.title: Deuteronomy 30:5
segments: and Jehovah thy God will bring thee into the land that thy fathers possessed, and thou shalt possess it; and he will do thee good, and multiply thee above thy fathers.

entries.title: Deuteronomy 30:6
segments: And Jehovah thy God will circumcise thy heart, and the heart of thy seed, to love Jehovah thy God with all thy heart and with all thy soul, that thou mayest live.

entries.title: Deuteronomy 30:7
segments: And Jehovah thy God will put all these curses on thine enemies, and on them that hate thee, who have persecuted thee.

entries.title: Deuteronomy 30:8
segments: But thou shalt return and hearken to the voice of Jehovah, and do all his commandments which I command thee this day.

entries.title: Deuteronomy 30:9
segments: And Jehovah thy God will make thee abound in every work of thy hand, in the fruit of thy body, and in the fruit of thy cattle, and in the fruit of thy ground, for good; for Jehovah will again rejoice over thee for good, as he rejoiced over thy fathers;

entries.title: Deuteronomy 30:10
segments: if thou shalt hearken unto the voice of Jehovah thy God, to keep his commandments and his statutes which are written in this book of the law; if thou turn to Jehovah thy God with all thy heart and with all thy soul.

entries.title: Deuteronomy 30:11
segments: ¶For this commandment which I command thee this day is not too wonderful for thee, neither is it far off.

entries.title: Deuteronomy 30:12
segments: It is not in the heavens, that thou shouldest say, Who shall go up for us to the heavens, and bring it to us, that we should hear it and do it?

entries.title: Deuteronomy 30:13
segments: And it is not beyond the sea, that thou shouldest say, Who shall go over the sea for us, and bring it to us, that we should hear it and do it?

entries.title: Deuteronomy 30:14
segments: For the word is very near to thee, in thy mouth and in thy heart, that thou mayest do it.

entries.title: Deuteronomy 30:15
segments: ¶See, I have set before thee this day life and good, and death and evil,

entries.title: Deuteronomy 30:16
segments: in that I command thee this day to love Jehovah thy God, to walk in his ways, and to keep his commandments and his statutes and his ordinances, that thou mayest live and multiply, and that Jehovah thy God may bless thee in the land whither thou goest to possess it.

entries.title: Deuteronomy 30:17
segments: But if thy heart turn away, so that thou wilt not hear, but shalt be drawn away, and thou shalt bow down to other gods and serve them;

entries.title: Deuteronomy 30:18
segments: I denounce unto you this day that ye shall surely perish; ye shall not prolong your days upon the land whereunto thou passest over the Jordan to possess it.

entries.title: Deuteronomy 30:19
segments: I call heaven and earth to witness this day against you: life and death have I set before you, blessing and cursing: choose then life, that thou mayest live, thou and thy seed,

entries.title: Deuteronomy 30:20
segments: in loving Jehovah thy God, in hearkening to his voice, and in cleaving to him--for this is thy life and the length of thy days--that thou mayest dwell in the land which Jehovah swore unto thy fathers, to Abraham, to Isaac, and to Jacob, to give them.
